behavior: On Mac startup resolve selected-resource bookmarks to their current filesystem locations
Keep up to 16 previous locations per resource in private bookmark storage
Before linked-project decoding recover missing absolute media paths from unique accessible bookmarked identities
Apply recovery to project open/drop/Finder, autosave recovery and saved-delivery decoding
Include video, stills and retained-original path/originalPath references
Retain move history when a newly selected folder groups current file grants
Do not rewrite the project file on disk until the user saves
Deserialize through bounded path-only IPC batches; embedded PCM, names and unrelated text stay in the frontend
boundaries: Never substitute an existing accessible path
Never choose between conflicting bookmarked identities
Never guess by basename or search unrelated folders
Canonical recovered folder descendants must stay inside the bookmarked folder, including symlink checks
No offline volume mounting or permission UI during startup
Old storage records default to empty history; all saved path history is bounded and validated

nativeIdentityTests.scope: Real Core Foundation app-scoped bookmark creation, serialized restoration and consecutive file/folder renames in isolated temporary fixtures; regular nonsandboxed test executable
checks: Two successive renames of a selected file and of a selected folder
Old and intermediate paths recover after separate store restorations
An unrelated replacement at the old path is preserved
Folder aliases, prefix boundaries and symlink escape

frontend.scope: One fresh full run of final source, maxWorkers=2, testTimeout=20000; command-scoped idle-sleep inhibition; repository timeout settings unchanged

validation.ios: Locked aarch64-apple-ios-sim compile PASS; existing unused MIDI method warning
validation.macBuild: Final normal debug app bundle PASS

limits: No new signed sandbox PowerBox/physical Finder gesture replay; earlier resource access evidence remains separate
Moves are discovered on app relaunch, not continuously while the app remains open
Copies to another volume or moves macOS cannot resolve retain manual relinking
Disconnected volumes and paths older than the retained history may require manual relinking
No physical iOS, microphone, audible output, commercial-plugin or external-interface checks
